title: still present since round 4: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state BEFORE the unsaved-changes guard fires
detail: Guard runs on the cleared model: the prompt offers to stay on VacancyEdit("v-…") whose demo store is already destroyed and demo_mode is False.
recommended_fix: On demo exits, run the dirty-edit guard against the pre-clear model (or skip the guard entirely — demo data is contractually disposable).

title: still present since round 4: demo dispatch arms remain unpinned — refcheck trio (UserChoseRefcheckAction/UserConfirmedRefcheckAction/UserSavedRefcheckEdit), single mark-read, edit deep-link get_for_edit, mark-opened threading
evidence:
client_test.gleam:6400: `let m = refcheck_detail_model([refcheck_call("rc-1", reference_call.Queued)])` — grep for `demo_mode: True` in client_test.gleam returns no matches (all refcheck dispatch tests are non-demo); demo_flow_test.gleam:471-476: `let #(after_skip, _) =
    demo_store.refcheck_action(
      store,
      "v-maples",
      "a-tom",
      "rc-tom-employer",
      "skip",
    )` (store-level only); grep for ApiReturnedApplicationOpened|get_for_edit|UserClickedNotification in client/test/demo/ returns no matches.
detail: demo_update.gleam's demo arms for the refcheck messages (481-505), single mark-read (551-554) and mark-opened threading have zero dispatch coverage — reverting their store threading stays green.
recommended_fix: Drive each arm through client.update from a demo model (the demo_mark_all_read pattern), one pin per arm.

title: update()'s policy-refetch wrapper lacks the demo guard its sibling has — a pre-entry in-flight 428 can fire a real /me while demo_mode is True, and the lint passes the site on the dispatcher's unrelated demo_mode case
detail: An authed landlord entering demo with a gated request in flight that 428s (mid-session policy bump, was_modal_open False) dispatches a policy-reject message; the wrapper fires real check_session in demo. The lint credits fn update's dispatcher `case model.demo_mode` — which does not guard this call site.
recommended_fix: Add `&& !next_model.demo_mode` to the wrapper condition (mirroring auth_became_success). Consider excluding fn update's dispatcher case from guard matching for later call sites.

title: still present since round 4: failed demo seed desyncs model.route (Landing) from the browser URL — no navigation effect, no toast (reset_demo's Error arm was fixed; enter_demo's was not)
detail: On seed failure the URL still shows /vacancies/v-maples while the model renders Landing — refresh behaves differently than the live route.
recommended_fix: Mirror reset_demo's W16 fix: brand-voice toast plus modem.push("/", …) on the Error arm.

title: still present since round 4: deep-link demo boots fire only demo_entry — per-surface analytics undercount the primary entry path
evidence: client.gleam:5813 (enter_demo's only capture): `demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_entry)` ; surface captures exist only inside handle_browser_change — 5233: `demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_vacancy_open)`, 5339: `demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_application_open)`, 5367: `demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_archived_open)` ; boot path bypasses it, client.gleam:237-239: `let #(demo_model, demo_eff) = enter_demo(base_model, route)`
detail: Deep-link entry (init and the W8 nav re-entry) never passes through handle_browser_change, so the landing surface's open event is never counted.
recommended_fix: Capture the route's surface event inside demo_entry_effects (or enter_demo) for the deep-linked route.

title: still present since round 4: comparison deep link passes persisted real sessionStorage ids into the demo store, skipping the empty-ids guard
evidence:
client.gleam demo_entry_effects: `routes.Comparison(vid) -> [
      demo_api.fetch_comparison(
        store,
        vid,
        load_comparison_ids(),
        ApiReturnedComparisonDetails,
      ),
    ]` (load_comparison_ids reads the real "rt_comparison_ids" sessionStorage, see save_comparison_ids at client.gleam:6741-6748: `case storage.session() {`)
detail: Real comparison ids (real application UUIDs) leak into the demo store's comparison resolution on a deep-linked /vacancies/v-…/compare boot.
recommended_fix: Seed the demo comparison from fixture ids (or pass []) instead of load_comparison_ids() in demo_entry_effects.

title: still present since round 4: edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame (no vacancy_edit_loading)
detail: First frame of /vacancies/v-maples/edit shows the blank form (real ids flash empty fields) before the store response lands.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when route is VacancyEdit, like handle_browser_change does.

title: still present since round 4: demo boot skips the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the page lifetime
detail: After exiting the demo via nav, the listeners are never installed for the page's remaining lifetime — real-mode behaviour differs from a normal boot.
recommended_fix: Install the background listeners on demo exit (or batch them in init unconditionally, guarding their effects on demo_mode).

title: still present since round 4: demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals write to real web storage
detail: Demo actions persist to real sessionStorage — spec says "no persistence of any kind"; a later real session inherits demo-written ids/dismissals.
recommended_fix: Guard the save_* calls with model.demo_mode (skip writes in demo), mirroring the fetch-side demo branches.

title: still present since round 4: latent policy re-acceptance modal could surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST (UserAcceptedPolicy is EXEMPT_ARMS, not intercepted)
evidence:
client.gleam:1375-1384: `UserAcceptedPolicy ->
      case model.policy_reaccept_loading {
        True -> #(model, effect.none())
        False -> #(
          Model(..model, policy_reaccept_loading: True),
          auth_api.accept_policy(` ; lint_demo_network.py:62-63: `"UserAcceptedPolicy",
    "ApiReturnedAcceptPolicy",` ; demo_fixtures.gleam:26: `"accepted_policy_version":"2026-05-23"`
detail: Latent until a real policy bump: an authed landlord entering demo carries a newer server_policy_version, the modal renders, and accepting fires a real POST with the demo csrf.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update.handle (no-op with the settings notice), or force server_policy_version to the fixture's on demo entry.

title: still present since round 4: enter_demo bypasses the full navigation reset — no polling cancellation, no landing-video reset, no focus-trap uninstall
evidence:
handle_browser_change resets (client.gleam:5088: `landing_intro_video_playing: False,` ; 5099-5100: `payment_polling: None,
      payment_poll_count: 0,`) are absent from enter_demo's reset block (5840-5861), which resets only dropdowns/confirms/modals/checkout fields and fires no `policy_reaccept_modal_focus.uninstall()` effect
detail: Entering demo from a payment-polling or popover-open page carries that state into the sandbox; comment claims it mirrors handle_browser_change but doesn't fully.
recommended_fix: Reset payment_polling/payment_poll_count/scoring_generation/landing_intro_video_playing and uninstall the focus trap in enter_demo.

title: still present since round 4: unreachable routes.Demo arm in view_protected_page duplicates the demo render
detail: Dead-by-construction arm duplicates view_demo_page's body; must be kept manually in sync if the demo dashboard render changes.
recommended_fix: Render element.none() (or a shared helper both call) in the exhaustive-but-dead arm instead of duplicating the dashboard render.

title: still present since round 4: dead routes.Dashboard arms in enter_demo/demo_entry_effects — Dashboard never reaches enter_demo
detail: The Dashboard halves of these arms are unreachable; is_demo_route deliberately excludes Dashboard, so the branches mislead readers.
recommended_fix: Drop `| routes.Dashboard` from both cases (keep routes.Demo), or document why the defensive arm stays.

title: still present since round 4: download_timeout duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam (store_of half now fully delegated)
detail: Two implementations of the same timeout must be kept in sync by hand; the store_of duplication was fixed but this one remains.
recommended_fix: Make demo_update call a shared pub'd helper (or client.gleam's) instead of mirroring it.

title: still present since round 4 (pin half of the mark-all-read finding): the model-level unread_count pin is vacuous — demo_model() starts at unread_count 0
evidence:
demo_flow_test.gleam:594-605: `let m = demo_model()
  let #(after, _) = client.update(m, msg.UserClickedMarkAllRead)
  ...
  after.unread_count |> should.equal(0)` ; demo_model() (29-38) builds `..model.initial()` whose default is model.gleam:695 `unread_count: 0,` ; the fix under test is demo_update.gleam:570 `#(Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next), unread_count: 0), eff)`
detail: The optimistic unread_count fix landed (code verified) but reverting it stays green — the pin starts at 0, so 0→0 can't fail. Store-level asserts do bite.
recommended_fix: Start the pin from unread_count: 2 (like demo_exit_clears_demo_data_test) so the optimistic clear is asserted.
